newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Vermilion Field produces natgas.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Vermilion Field produces natgas.

text.p: Ashland Inc said on Monday that its Vermilion 410 Field is producing 45 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from four wells in its platform.

The maximum initial production at the block offshore Louisiana is expecting in early 1997 at a rate of about 100 million cubic feet of gas per day, Ashland said. The field is located in about 360 feet of water, 105 miles offshore the Vermilion Parish.
Eight wells will be producing from two platforms by the end of the month, Ashland said.
The field is expected to reach the 100 million cubic feet production level in early February, Ashland Exploration Inc spokesman Mark Pierce said.
Ashland has a 50 percent working interest in the field and is the operator for a group that includes the MOXY/MCN venture, with 37.5 percent, and Energen Corp with 12.5 percent.
The MOXY/MCN venture interest is shared 40 percent by McMoRan Oil & Gas Co and 60 percent by MCN Corp.
